pages.title: A Change of Air
pages.text: One air stream becomes a processing tool; extra shafts let you arrange separate workstations.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use an installed washing recipe shown in JEI. The water belongs in the fan’s processing stream; a placed fan alone does not count.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Drive an Encased Fan through water, fire or lava toward suitable inputs. Wash, smoke or smelt items; unsuitable food can burn in the lava setup.
